violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface * was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. . Refrigerator door handle broken and temporary fixed with duct tape.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. . Dishwasher sanitizer measured 0ppm. Air in the lines and unable to prime the unit.
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. = Cabinet faces and door handles require cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface * was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. - Door handle broken and repaired with duct tape.
